keyVerseDR: "I am the vine: you the branches. He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit..." (Jn 15:5)

level1.title: The Vine and Branches
level1.story: Jesus said, "I am the vine, and you are the branches." Branches need to stay on the vine to grow grapes. We stay close to Jesus!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you stay close to Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me stay close to You. Amen.

activity.title: Fingerprint grapes
activity.intro: Make grapes on the vine with your fingerprints.
activity.prompt: A big vine with branches full of fingerprint grapes: Jesus is the vine

level2.title: Remain in Me
level2.story: Jesus said, "I am the true vine; and My Father is the husbandman." Every branch that bears fruit, He prunes so that it may bring forth more fruit. Jesus said, "Abide in Me, and I in you." A branch cannot bear fruit by itself unless it stays on the vine. "I am the vine: you the branches: he that abideth in Me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit."
level2.keyLine: I am the vine: you the branches.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does 'pruning' mean in our lives?
What fruit does Jesus want you to bear?
level2.prayer: Jesus, keep me connected to You. Amen.
